name: Alkem Laboratories Ltd
title: Alkem Laboratories Ltd - 539523 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Alkem FY26 revenue up 13.5% to INR147bn with EBITDA margin 20.4%, but management flagged geopolitical cost pressure, trade generics growth slowing to ~4.3%, and CEO exit with no FY27 margin expansion assured.

triggers.label: API and packaging cost inflation flagged
triggers.quote: there is an impact on first quarter. There will be impact going forward also if the situation doesn’t improve from here.

triggers.label: Margin +100bp/yr now 'moving goalpost'
triggers.quote: In the current scenario, it's a moving goalpost.

triggers.label: Trade generics growth ~4.3%
triggers.quote: the growth has been lesser as far as trade generic is concerned, it's close to around 4.3% on an annualized basis

triggers.label: Chronic outperformance vs IPM 250bp in Q4
triggers.quote: chronic segment reported 16.1% versus the IPM growth of 13.6%

triggers.label: FY27 FX-neutral US high single digit
triggers.quote: we are looking at a high single -digit margin and the currency gain would add up to that

guidance.quote: we should be within the range of 20% to 21%

guidance.metric: India branded generics growth vs IPM
guidance.quote: we will grow 100 to 150 basis points higher than the market
The number will be around 27% to 29% going forward.
the other expenses can increase by 7% to 8%, not beyond that
we expect it to be similar between 4% to 5% even in the coming year
we don't foresee any further investment into acquisitions at least for the next 12 months

prior_guidance_check.quote: that is more on a more stable and a like -to-like period

red_flags.label: Trade generics receivables and sales cutoff issues
red_flags.quote: There are challenges in that business in terms of the overall receivables that can happen.

red_flags.label: CEO departure and search underway
red_flags.quote: we will look for a CEO. We have engaged with the top 3 global head and up for this.

evasions.quote: We have not called out segment-wise profitability anyways.
I will not share any numbers in this call regarding how much will be the impact
So, there's still some time. And second thing, keep in mind that we don't have a basket yet.
